summary: ArbiCore UI v2 Slice 1 end-to-end verification. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed for /api/arbicore/opportunities (list, family/verdict/min_confidence filters, detail shape with reasoning/verification/quote/sizing/evidence, approve, reject). Frontend: 30/31 UI checks passed on preview URL. Home shows all 3 bands (6 pulse cards, 3 priorities cards, vitals card), fresh items render, VIEW ALL CTA navigates. Opportunities page renders 8 rows; family/verdict/chain/minconf filters reduce rows correctly; empty-state message 'X opportunities match the current filters' appears with gate-reason guidance for LAUNCH+HARD_NO+minconf 0.8. Drawer opens on row click, all 6 tabs (overview/reasoning/verification/quote/sizing/evidence) present + verdict/conf/safety/fresh pills, tab switching works, reasoning shows confidence factors, approve button triggers POST and shows toast. Command palette opens via header trigger and Meta+K/Ctrl+K, has 7 nav items + 8 opp items, closes on Esc, navigate items route correctly. Keyboard shortcuts: ArrowDown updates focus (var(--v2-bg-selected) applied) and Enter opens the drawer for the focused row (verified once the v2-opportunities section is focused).

issues: Radix a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Wrap the palette DialogTitle in Radix VisuallyHidden or expose a visible title.

action_items: Minor a11y: add a VisuallyHidden <DialogTitle> to CommandPalette DialogContent to silence the Radix warning shown in the browser console.

UX consideration (non-blocking): keyboard shortcuts on /v2/opportunities require the section to receive focus first (tabIndex=0 on the section). Consider attaching the listener to window (with drawer/input guards) so ArrowDown/Enter/A/R work immediately on page load without an explicit focus event.
critical_code_review_comments: OpportunitiesPage keyboard handler is attached via onKeyDown on the section with tabIndex=0; user must click into the section before shortcuts work. The hint text 'use ↑↓ to move, Enter to open' implies it works immediately — either auto-focus the section on mount or promote the handler to a window listener (matches CommandPalette hook pattern).

chainOpts is derived from the currently-filtered items list (line 81-84 OpportunitiesPage.jsx). Consequence: applying a family filter can remove chain chips that would otherwise widen the result. Better UX: derive chain (and verdict/family) chip lists from the unfiltered universe so users can pivot filters without them disappearing.

Backend v2_opportunity_detail returns HTTP 200 with an error body when opp_id is not found (line 249-250 server.py) instead of raising HTTPException(404). Frontend will fail unpredictably. Return a proper 404 with a Pydantic error model.

In-memory _V2_OPPS is mutated by approve/reject with no per-request isolation — state persists across requests and workers, which is fine for the pod stub but must be replaced by the canonical DB-backed handler before VPS deploy (already noted as stub).
CommandPalette missing DialogTitle triggers a Radix accessibility console error on every open. Simple fix, ship in Slice 1.
